argv: uname -r; cat /etc/os-release; cat /proc/cmdline; pacman -Q linux linux-headers linux-lts linux-lts-headers dkms nvidia-open-dkms nvidia-dkms nvidia-utils mkinitcpio limine 2>/dev/null; cat /etc/default/limine; cat /etc/mkinitcpio.conf; ls /etc/mkinitcpio.conf.d /etc/mkinitcpio.d; command -v limine-mkinitcpio; lspci -Dnn -d 10de:; ls /usr/lib/modules; test ! -d /sys/module/gpu_unlock; printf "gpu_unlock_absent=%s\n" "$?"
command: bash -x -c 'uname -r; cat /etc/os-release; cat /proc/cmdline; pacman -Q linux linux-headers linux-lts linux-lts-headers dkms nvidia-open-dkms nvidia-dkms nvidia-utils mkinitcpio limine 2>/dev/null; cat /etc/default/limine; cat /etc/mkinitcpio.conf; ls /etc/mkinitcpio.conf.d /etc/mkinitcpio.d; command -v limine-mkinitcpio; lspci -Dnn -d 10de:; ls /usr/lib/modules; test ! -d /sys/module/gpu_unlock; printf "gpu_unlock_absent=%s\n" "$?"'
